name: Synthetic Ground Roll Noise
description: A synthetic 3D seismic benchmark built on the SEG China 3D (SEGC3) geological model. It consists of 9 shot lines with 201 crosslines and 201 inlines, sampled at 625 time steps. Synthetic ground-roll noise is injected to simulate realistic coherent surface-wave interference, providing a controlled testbed for evaluating coherent noise suppression and ground-roll attenuation methods.

name: Field Land Survey Denoising
description: Real-world onshore vibroseis seismic records acquired from the Sichuan Basin. The dataset features strong ground-roll interference and ambient cultural noise typical of land surveys. Reference clean volumes are obtained through long-stack averaging, offering a realistic field-data testbed for benchmarking denoising algorithms under complex near-surface conditions.

name: Synthetic 2D Interpolation
description: A 2D synthetic marine shot-gather dataset generated via acoustic finite-difference modeling on a layered velocity model with Ricker wavelet sources. Fifty percent of traces are randomly removed to simulate realistic acquisition gaps, designed for testing trace interpolation, reconstruction, and data recovery algorithms under controlled conditions.

name: Synthetic Random Noise
description: Shot gathers from the classic Marmousi velocity model contaminated with additive Gaussian white noise at varying input SNR levels ranging from -5 dB to +10 dB. This benchmark tests the robustness and generalization of random noise suppression methods across different noise regimes and signal-to-noise conditions.

name: Synthetic First Arrival (varying SNR)
description: Synthetic refraction shot records with exact ground-truth first-break times obtained directly from wavefront modeling. The dataset spans a wide input SNR range from -5 dB to 20 dB, designed to rigorously test the robustness and accuracy of first-arrival picking algorithms under both noisy and clean conditions.

name: Synthetic 2D Super-Resolution
description: High-resolution 2D synthetic marine shot gathers and their 2× spatially downsampled counterparts. Designed for benchmarking seismic super-resolution methods on recovering spatially subsampled data and restoring high-frequency geological details lost during downsampling.
